logp.method_description: Partition coefficients (log P) of Cu(II) Schiff base ligand and complexes were determined by spectroscopy method. Octanolsaturated water (OSW) and water-saturated octanol were prepared using analytical grade actanol and milli-Q water. Aliquots of stock solutions of ligand and copper complexes in OSW were added to equal volumes of WSO and shaken in an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C shaker for 24 h at 250 rpm after partition. The aqueous and octanol layers were carefully separated into test tubes for copper analysis. Aqueous samples before and after partitioning were analysed by spectroscopy method calibrated with aqueous standards. Partition coefficients of compounds were calculated using the equation log Poct = log ([compound]oct / [compound]aq).
